summary: Representative single barrel-shaped, dimpled roller from a 44-roller replacement pack for 104 mm mecanum wheels. It has an axial through-bore at the center. The pack also includes loose hardware: a pin, 2 bearings, E-clips and shims.
notes: No dimensions are given in the listing. The bounds are for one roller, centered on the part, with its long axis along z. Assumptions: the roller's max diameter is about 20 mm and its length about 44 mm. These come from the roller's length-to-diameter ratio of roughly 2.2:1 in the photo, and from fitting a ring of about 10 rollers inside a 104 mm wheel in the third image. The 8 mm bore is a rough estimate from the visible end opening, at roughly 40% of the roller diameter. It also assumes the bore holds the bearings and pin. No flat mounting surfaces are visible or stated, so none are listed. The loose pin, E-clips, shims and bearings are not modeled.
